summary: Tested Iter43 review request: (1) /api/version fix to not depend on .git, (2) VIDAL Tester modal in Admin Settings. ALL backend tests pass (4/4 new + 17/17 prior). Frontend modal works: 7 tester buttons present, request introspection shows method/URL/params with app_key masked as '***', execute auto-switches to Response tab and displays HTTP status / content-type / raw body (incl. VIDAL upstream errors gracefully), POST action shows editable XML body textarea, ESC key closes modal. Minor: close-button click had a 1-shot timing flake (modal still counted as 1 after click), but ESC works reliably; likely a stale DOM read due to concurrent toast — non-blocking.

ui_bugs.issue: Close button (X) occasionally requires a second click — possibly because admin-settings concurrent toast (e.g. 'Connexion Qdrant OK', 'Opération effectuée avec succès') triggers a re-render that swallows the first click. ESC key always works.

action_items: (optional/low) Investigate the close-button flake on VidalActionTesterModal — likely a focus/race with admin-settings toasts. ESC works fine.
(noted) VIDAL upstream is unreachable from preview (expected). Modal correctly surfaces _error structure with status=0, message='VIDAL injoignable', raw body '[Erreur réseau VIDAL]'.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is very large (>23k lines per warnings) — should be split into smaller modules over time.
Pydantic V1 `@validator` deprecation warnings in emergentintegrations + several `regex=` Query params in /app/backend/routes/vidal.py and routes/amm.py should migrate to `pattern=` (Pydantic V2).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows OK; minor close-button click flake)

test_credentials: admin@sawalismartsystems.com / Admin@Sawali2026 (OTP via dev_otp on login response, verify-otp uses field 'code')
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth fast-track in browser uses localStorage keys 'sawali_token' and 'sawali_user' (AuthContext.jsx). Briefing modal blocks UI on /admin/settings — set localStorage.sawali_briefing_dismissed='true' or press ESC before interacting. The VIDAL Actions section is reachable via the [role='tab']:has-text('VIDAL') tab in admin settings; scroll [data-testid='vidal-actions-section'] into view. The 7 default actions are: recherche, produit, documents, produit_status, package, alerts_full, interactions — each has a 🧪 Tester button at [data-testid='vidal-action-{id}-test']. VIDAL upstream (api.vidal.fr) is unreachable from the preview container, which is the documented scenario the tester modal helps diagnose.
rca of the issue: N/A — both reported features (version no-git + VIDAL Tester) are implemented correctly and verified via backend pytest + Playwright end-to-end.
